maddeler.e:
استعلمن (form X)
# اِسْتَعْلَمْنَ (istaʕlamna) /is.taʕ.lam.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَعْلَمَ (istaʕlama)
# اُسْتُعْلِمْنَ (ustuʕlimna) /us.tuʕ.lim.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَعْلَمَ (istaʕlama)
# اِسْتَعْلِمْنَ (istaʕlimna) /is.taʕ.lim.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَعْلَمَ (istaʕlama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
